restaurants.name: Moz Café
restaurants.hours: 08:00 am – 08:30 pm; open only till 2pm on Monday; closed on Sunday
highlights: Small restaurant on the second floor of a small building
Serves coffee, beer, wine and dessert

Fresh fish served in a variety of styles, plus steak and chicken

Savory options including burgers, salads and local fish and meat dishes
